channel.title: Notable Artists Born Today
channel.description: RSS feed of notable writers, poets, directors, and actors born on this day in history.

item.title: David Jenkins (television writer)
item.description: David Jenkins is an American television writer, producer, director, and showrunner. He created the sitcoms Our Flag Means Death for HBO Max and People of Earth for TBS.

item.title: Peter James (writer)
item.description: Peter John James (born 22 August 1948) is a British writer of crime. He was born in Brighton, the son of Cornelia James, the former glovemaker to Queen Elizabeth II.

item.title: Joe Castiglione (athletic director)
item.description: Joseph Robert Castiglione (born October 8, 1957) is a former director of athletics at the University of Missouri and the University of Oklahoma. During his time as the University of Oklahoma's athletic director from 1998 to 2025, the school won a total of 26 national championships in football (2000); softball (2000, 2013, 2016, 2017, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); men's golf (2017); men's gymnastics (2002, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2008, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018); and women's gymnastics (2014, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2025).

item.title: Christopher Stone (actor)
item.description: Christopher Stone (born Thomas Edward Bourassa; October 4, 1940 – October 20, 1995) was an American actor.

item.title: James Olson (actor)
item.description: James Olson (October 8, 1930 – April 17, 2022) was an American actor.

item.title: Jesse Johnson (actor)
item.description: Jesse Wayne Johnson (born December 7, 1982) is an American actor. He is the son of actors Don Johnson and Patti D'Arbanville.
